notes:
Lead profile: mid-sized DTC home goods brand. Heavy seasonal/weekend spikes (Black Friday-level burst planning). Primary data stack: Shopify storefront + BigQuery nightly exports. Product catalog ~4.5k SKUs, lots of variants and sparse attributes. Wants: fast on-site product Q&A widget, automated enrichment (category tags, material, care instructions), and improved search relevance for long-tail queries. Preference for hosted API for quick time-to-value; cost sensitive — expects initial monthly spend <$2k during PoC.

Discovery call highlights:
- "We're not ready to self-host — need something that just works with Shopify." — CTO
- Concerned about token bill shock when traffic spikes; asked about rate-limiting and per-route budgeting.
- Likes idea of model fallback: a smaller cheaper model for non-conversational queries.
- Wants embeddings for similarity search but unclear on vector store choices.

Technical constraints / asks:
- Latency target: median <200ms for Q&A widget (P95 <500ms acceptable).
- Throughput: burst to ~250 concurrent sessions during promotions.
- Catalog enrichment: need bulk attribute extraction pipeline (existing CSV + image alt text). Expect ~5k records initial.
- Retention: 90-day logs + audit trail for changes to enrichment; SOC2 compliance preferred.

POC plan suggested by AE/SE:
- 1) Small hosted API PoC: ingest 500 SKUs, run retrieval-augmented Q&A demo on storefront (2 weeks).
- 2) Evaluate embeddings vs reranker for search (A/B) during PoC; measure latency/cost tradeoffs.
- 3) Rollout plan for burst capacity and fallback policies if cost > threshold.

- Recommended models/quantization profiles for cost vs latency on hosted API.
